state_contract.qualification: Pinned static FP16 output shapes bound requested copies; Job memory limit also applies. Runtime returned shape/dtype are checked before statistics.

states.qualification: Final state observations are not the first failed layer/chunk. get_output copies existing outputs; no model forward is requested.

greedy.cache_mode: native OGA Generator append_tokens/generate_next_token; no external recurrent-state inputs

prefix64_state_statistics_comparison.qualification: Hashes identify JSON statistics records, not raw state tensors. Equal statistics do not prove equal arrays.

limitations: Historical unpruned versus subsequent pruned runs; same inputs/runtime, not randomized paired trials.
Prefix raw logits can be compared bytewise; raw state tensors/hashes were not saved, so statistics equality is not bit equality.
Numerical differences and correctness are reported separately; no new tolerance or acceptance criterion is fitted after measurement.
Seven direct diagnostic cases and one greedy example do not establish general Speed/Quality suite performance.
This snapshot does not establish pruned 16K or near-boundary behavior.
Published evidence contains aggregate state statistics and hashes, not raw arrays/model activations/weights.
